theme.description: Opinionated visual minimalism. A black canvas with pure white typography, relying entirely on stark contrast, grid-based layouts, and negative space to convey premium performance. No decorative gradients, no unnecessary colors.

colors.note: Semantic colors are overridden to pure white to maintain the strict black-and-white aesthetic. Use icons (e.g., check, warning) and subtle opacity changes instead of colors to convey status.

spacing_and_layout.note: Strictly cardless or sharp-edged containers. No rounded corners (rounded-none). Generous padding.

buttons.primary: bg-accent text-accent_foreground hover:bg-white/90 px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-border text-text_primary hover:bg-surface_secondary px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors rounded-none

components.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-border hover:border-border_hover focus:border-white focus:ring-0 px-0 py-3 rounded-none text-white outline-none transition-colors
components.cards: bg-surface border border-border p-6 hover:border-border_hover transition-colors rounded-none
components.console_window: bg-[#050505] border border-border p-4 font-mono text-sm text-text_secondary overflow-x-auto h-64 overflow-y-auto
components.table_header: border-b border-border py-4 text-text_muted font-medium text-sm uppercase tracking-wider

iconography.style: stroke-width: 1.5, sharp lines, pure white or text_secondary

hero.layout: Centered, massive typography. 'High performance Servers & Designs at a low performance price'. Background is pure black with subtle digital noise texture.
hero.ctas: Row of 'Start for Free' (Primary) and 'Choose Premium Plans' (Secondary).

landing.pricing: Side-by-side sharp cards for Free and Premium hosting plans.
landing.services: Bento grid showcasing Video Editing and Website Design.
landing.vps_enquiry: A minimal form triggering a ticket creation.
landing.legal: Simple, text-heavy pages with generous left-aligned typography.

dashboard_user.layout: Sidebar navigation (Servers, Tickets, Billing, Account). Main content area.
dashboard_user.home: List of servers (imitating Pterodactyl). Status indicated by a filled/unfilled circle icon.
dashboard_user.server_detail: Top stats row (CPU, RAM, Disk). Main area: Terminal console. Sidebar: File manager, Plugin downloader (Minecraft).
dashboard_user.tickets: Table of user tickets (Support, Design, Video Editing). 'Create Ticket' modal.

dashboard_admin.users: Table to manage users, roles (staff, admin, engineer).
dashboard_admin.tickets: Kanban or dense table to reply and manage service/support tickets.
dashboard_admin.settings: Form to link Pterodactyl panel via API.

auth.layout: Split screen: left side minimal form, right side abstract black-and-white texture.

testing.rule: All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the black and white theme. Do not use gradients or saturated colors.
Use 'rounded-none' for all components to achieve a brutalist, sharp look.
Implement the landing page, user dashboard (Pterodactyl clone interface), admin panel, and auth flows as described.
Ensure the terminal console in the server view uses JetBrains Mono and mimics a real server output window.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
